stories.title: Worries swirl that Russia is planning to test NATO with direct attacks
stories.summary: NPR's Elissa Nadworny speaks with Kurt Volker, former U.S. ambassador to NATO, about worries that Russia's "hybrid attacks" could lead to a direct military confrontation with NATO.

stories.title: Could Germany's far-right AfD party gain ground in liberal Berlin?
stories.summary: The far-right AfD is campaigning in neighborhoods it previously would never have gone near, marking a noteworthy shift in the left-leaning capital city, where local elections take place on Sunday.

stories.title: Why one university is standing up to Trump's DEI rollbacks
stories.summary: The President of Sacramento State talks about their Black honors college -- and how schools are dealings with DEI under the Trump administration.

stories.title: Ole Miss and LSU face off in a rivalry made more bitter by Lane Kiffin's return
stories.summary: Lane Kiffin brings his LSU Tigers to the University of Mississippi for a highly-anticipated football game. Kiffin led Ole Miss for the past few seasons but bolted for LSU, angering many.

stories.title: Taiwan's lost films hold the sounds and stories of a vanishing era
stories.summary: Researchers in Taiwan are racing to restore a crucial piece of the island's film history, before it's lost forever.

stories.title: 'Joyful protestors' talk about the cultural value of the Kennedy Center
stories.summary: The center, a beacon of American arts and culture, is slated to be closed after a board vote. On Friday, a group called Hands Off the Arts is holding what they call a "joyful protest" outside.
